test_title: PYST 20: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 18 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What is the tenure of a member of the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)?

options.text: 5 years or till attainment of 65 years of age
4 years or till attainment of 60 years of age
6 years or till attainment of the age of 65 years

solution:
The correct answer is __**6 years or till attainment of the age of 65 years**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The tenure of a member of the **Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)** is set at **6 years or till the attainment of the age of 65 years**, whichever is earlier, as per the provisions in the **Constitution of India**.
 
• This ensures that the members of the UPSC have a defined tenure and cannot hold office indefinitely, maintaining accountability and efficiency in their functioning.
 
• The **age limit of 65 years** ensures that only active and capable individuals serve in this prestigious position. *Hence, the correct answer is 6 years or till the attainment of the age of 65 years.*
 
• As per the Constitution, members of the **UPSC** cannot hold any other office of profit or employment under the government of India or state governments during their tenure.
 
• The **UPSC** is a constitutional body established under **Article 315** of the Constitution, and its members are appointed by the President of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Union Public Service Commission (UPSC):**

 
 
• The **UPSC** is India's premier central recruiting agency. It is responsible for conducting examinations for recruitment to various services of the Union, including the **Civil Services Examination**, Indian Forest Service Examination, and others.
 
• It functions independently under the provisions of the Constitution and ensures fair recruitment processes for the government of India.
 
 
 
• **Appointment of Members:**
 
 
• The members of the **UPSC** are appointed by the **President of India**.
 
• The composition of UPSC includes a Chairman and other members, the number of which is determined by the President.
 
 
 
• **Functions of UPSC:**
 
 
• The main function is to conduct examinations for appointments to the **All India Services**, **Central Services**, and other allied services.
 
• It advises the government on matters related to recruitment, transfer, promotion, and disciplinary actions.
 
 
 
• **Conditions of Service:**
 
 
• The conditions of service of the Chairman and members of the UPSC are governed by the Constitution and cannot be altered to their disadvantage after their appointment.
 
• The members are not eligible for reappointment to the same office after completing their tenure.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Article 315 to 323:**

 
 
• These articles in the Constitution deal with the composition, appointment, and functions of the **Union Public Service Commission** and the **State Public Service Commissions**.
 
• Article 316 specifies the terms and conditions of service and tenure of the Chairman and members of the UPSC.
 
 
 
• **Historical Background:**
 
 
• The **UPSC** was established in **1926** as the Public Service Commission by the British Government and later became a constitutional body after independence.
 
• Its primary objective is to ensure merit-based recruitment, transparency, and non-partisanship in the civil services.
